name: mystic_forge_permission_ends_when_it_leaves
notes: Printed: 'You may cast artifact spells and colorless spells from the top of your library.' A static ability: it works while the Forge is on the battlefield (CR 604.2, 611.3a). Bag of Holding on top is cast from the library for {1}; the Forge is then destroyed (another effect), and the second Bag of Holding, now on top, is not offered although {1} is left in the pool.
